name: TG-H S/N substantive-context remediation audit
failure_analysis: Prior QA was mostly nonempty-field and localization validation, missing explicit retrieval of the research and news catalogs.
Previous case contexts were generally event summaries plus negative claims (not a route, don't infer species), without substantive cross-case intelligence.
Placing the primary event news article in [O] is appropriate; [N] should be another independently cataloged relevant report, not a duplicate event retelling.
A fixed minimum count of S/N/I would create artificial contexts. Sources must have specific factual findings and clear limits.
Scientific and news catalog descriptions are discovery aids; empirical claims may require independent source-text verification before stronger interpretation.
method: Primary [O] preserved; where specifically relevant, [S] paper DOI and/or [N] separately cataloged report appended with concrete findings, relevance and non-linkage caveat in PT/EN/ES; same marker and URL in all bibliography fields and context_references.
remaining_work: The other 39 new cases have not received substantive S/N additions this turn; individually review A/B match and record justified absence rather than forcing citations.
Institutional reports [I] are a 15-item catalog, but their PDF content has not been read/validated in this pass; no I citations added.
Review live rendered card, full bibliographic source links and future ingestion checks.
Run repository heuristic context-quality audit; requires checked-out repository or automation pipeline and is not proof of semantic quality.
status: 8 records updated and committed; no quantities, routes or dates changed.
